#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string sLine;
    std::cin >> sLine;
    std::vector<char> s(sLine.begin(), sLine.end());

    std::vector<int> counts(3, 0);
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> positions(3);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int type = (s[i] == 'K') ? 0 : (s[i] == 'V') ? 1 : 2;
        positions[type].push_back(i);
        counts[type]++;
    }

    int maxA = counts[0], maxB = counts[1], maxC = counts[2];

    // Initialize 4D DP array with large values
    std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>> dp(2,
        std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>(maxA + 1,
            std::vector<std::vector<int>>(maxB + 1,
                std::vector<int>(maxC + 1, INT_MAX / 2))));

    dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;

    for (int a = 0; a <= maxA; a++) {
        for (int b = 0; b <= maxB; b++) {
            for (int c = 0; c <= maxC; c++) {
                for (int lastFlag = 0; lastFlag < 2; lastFlag++) {
                    int currentCost = dp[lastFlag][a][b][c];
                    if (currentCost >= INT_MAX / 2) continue;

                    // Choose 'K' (type 0)
                    if (a < maxA && lastFlag == 0) {
                        int swaps = 0;
                        int posA = positions[0][a];
                        for (int i = b; i < maxB; i++) {
                            if (positions[1][i] < posA) swaps++;
                        }
                        for (int i = c; i < maxC; i++) {
                            if (positions[2][i] < posA) swaps++;
                        }
                        int nextA = a + 1;
                        int nextLastFlag = 0;
                        int newCost = currentCost + swaps;
                        if (dp[nextLastFlag][nextA][b][c] > newCost) {
                            dp[nextLastFlag][nextA][b][c] = newCost;
                        }
                    }

                    // Choose 'V' (type 1)
                    if (b < maxB) {
                        int swaps = 0;
                        int posB = positions[1][b];
                        for (int i = a; i < maxA; i++) {
                            if (positions[0][i] < posB) swaps++;
                        }
                        for (int i = c; i < maxC; i++) {
                            if (positions[2][i] < posB) swaps++;
                        }
                        int nextB = b + 1;
                        int nextLastFlag = 1;
                        int newCost = currentCost + swaps;
                        if (dp[nextLastFlag][a][nextB][c] > newCost) {
                            dp[nextLastFlag][a][nextB][c] = newCost;
                        }
                    }

                    // Choose 'C' (type 2)
                    if (c < maxC) {
                        int swaps = 0;
                        int posC = positions[2][c];
                        for (int i = a; i < maxA; i++) {
                            if (positions[0][i] < posC) swaps++;
                        }
                        for (int i = b; i < maxB; i++) {
                            if (positions[1][i] < posC) swaps++;
                        }
                        int nextC = c + 1;
                        int nextLastFlag = 0;
                        int newCost = currentCost + swaps;
                        if (dp[nextLastFlag][a][b][nextC] > newCost) {
                            dp[nextLastFlag][a][b][nextC] = newCost;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int answer = std::min(dp[0][maxA][maxB][maxC], dp[1][maxA][maxB][maxC]);
    std::cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
